params.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER: a small rounded terracotta-orange cartoon creature, a soft cube with four stubby legs, small nubs for arms, and two dot eyes. Image 2 is the SCENE, in which that same character is already drawn.

Keep Image 2 unchanged in every other respect — same camera, same framing, same fixtures, same wreck, same paper and palette, and every OTHER character in the picture exactly as drawn. This is a very wide cutaway of a whole room, so the character is a small part of the picture.

Change ONE thing: the small orange cube creature sitting at the foot of the towers of paper in the far left corner is now caught mid-action, flinging a finished page over its shoulder — one arm-nub thrown up high behind it, a sheet of paper in the air just above and behind it, and three or four more loose sheets frozen in the air around it at different angles, mid-fall. It still sits on the same spot at the same tiny size, still holds exactly ONE pencil in its other arm-nub, its two dot eyes wide. Nothing else about it changes.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no 3D. Do not add any text.
